The authoritative source or provider of the exchange rate data. Current lifecycle status of the exchange rate record. Active rates are currently in use, inactive rates are no longer valid, superseded rates have been replaced by newer rates, pending rates are awaiting approval, and draft rates are under preparation.

Classification of the exchange rate indicating its purpose and calculation method. Boolean indicator specifying whether this rate is designated for use in general ledger foreign currency revaluation processes. True indicates the rate should be used for balance sheet revaluation; false indicates it is for transactional purposes only.
